translation.from: O Allah, I ask Thee for security in this world
and keep me safe from the things which I fear

quote: never failed to utter these supplications in the evening and in the morning

adhkar.title: Knower of the unseen and the seen

translation.from: O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen

quote: Say it when you reach morning, and evening, and when you go to bed.

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing harms

translation.from: In the name of Allah, when Whose name is mentioned

quote: If anyone says three times
he will not suffer sudden affliction till the morning, and if anyone says this in the morning, he will not suffer sudden affliction till the evening

translation.from: Hallowed be Allah and all praise is due to Him

adhkar.title: La ilaha illallah wahdahu, a hundred times a day

translation.from: There is no god but Allah, the One

quote: one hundred times every day
that is a safeguard for him against the Satan on that day till evening

adhkar.title: Asking forgiveness, a hundred times a day

translation.from: I seek forgiveness from Allah

quote: I seek forgiveness from Allah a hundred times a day

quote: Had you recited these words in the evening

quote: he used to cup his hands together and blow over it after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nas, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub
He used to do that three times
Allah will appoint a guard for you who will stay with you and no satan will come near you till morning
spoke the truth, although he is an absolute liar
